question: Will Wesley Bell be the Democratic nominee for MO-01?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the nomination for the Democratic Party to contest the MO-01 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The Democratic primary will take place on August 4, 2026.

If no nominee is announced by November 3, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Democrat sources, including https://democrats.org/.

Any replacement of the nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

evidence.excerpt: Wesley Bell and Cori Bush face off again August 4 in the Democratic primary for Missouri’s 1st Congressional District. Three other candidates are running: Alissa Murphy, Carl E. Harris Sr. and Carl Ernest Henderson; none have formed committees to raise money for their campaigns. Federal Election Commission records show United Democracy Project had spent $1.1 million overall in the primary through the preceding Friday. Bush is betting that shifting public sentiment toward the Middle East, Bell’s support for Israel and the money supporting him could help her comeback.

Cori Bush spoke at a Monday-night online rally organized by Our Revolution, the group formed by Senator Bernie Sanders to advance the progressive movement. She was running against incumbent Representative Wesley Bell in a field with three other candidates. Bush cast a primary victory as a potential “knockout” punch to AIPAC.
United Democracy Project had spent $865,000 on television ads supporting Bell in Missouri’s 1st Congressional District, according to AdImpact.

Five candidates are running in the Democratic primary for Missouri’s 1st Congressional District on August 4, 2026. Incumbent Representative Wesley Bell and Cori Bush lead in noteworthy endorsements and fundraising. Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, Democratic Whip Katherine Clark and the Congressional Black Caucus PAC endorsed Bell. Senator Bernie Sanders, Our Revolution and St. Louis Democratic Socialists of America endorsed Bush.
